name: The Kinks

whyMatters.en: London band formed in 1963 with the Davies brothers, Pete Quaife, and Mick Avory (from the Rolling Stones orbit). Early Pye singles You Really Got Me and All Day and All of the Night used power-chord riffs later cited in hard rock; Ray Davies’s mid-60s albums shifted to English observational writing.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队，1963 年由 Davies 兄弟、Pete Quaife 与来自 Rolling Stones 圈子的 Mick Avory 组成。早期 Pye 单曲 You Really Got Me、All Day and All of the Night 的强力和弦 riff 后被 hard rock 引用；Ray Davies 在 60 年代中期专辑转向英式观察式写歌。

essentialTracks.title: All Day and All of the Night

lyricQuotes: Girl, you really got me going / You got me so I don't know what I'm doing

shortBio.en: Davies brothers, London, 1963–1996. Early Pye riff singles; Village Green and Lola mark the songwriting stretch; US Arista albums revived the charts in the late 1970s.
shortBio.zh: Davies 兄弟，伦敦，1963–1996。早期 Pye riff 单曲；Village Green 与 Lola 标记写歌阶段；70 年代末 Arista 时期专辑在美国榜回升。

body.en:
The Kinks formed in London in 1963. Ray and Dave Davies had played as the Ray Davies Quartet and The Ravens with schoolmate Pete Quaife on bass; that year they joined Mick Avory—from the Rolling Stones orbit—and signed to Pye.

After two failed singles, You Really Got Me (1964) reached UK #1 and US #7 on a plain guitar riff later cited as an early hard-rock model. All Day and All of the Night and Tired of Waiting for You followed; Sunny Afternoon and Waterloo Sunset were further UK hits written by Ray. Face to Face (1966) and Something Else by The Kinks (1967) kept the UK album run going. Internal friction and management issues kept the band off US tours for about four years.

Quaife left for three months in 1966 (John Dalton filled in) and left permanently by Arthur (Or the Decline and Fall of the British Empire) (1969). Lola and Apeman on Lola Versus Powerman and the Moneygoround Part One (1970) returned the band to the US Top 40; US radio often substituted “cherry cola” for “Coca-Cola” on Lola. Under RCA, UK chart singles nearly stopped; Celluloid Heroes on Everybody’s in Show-Biz (1972) is among Ray’s best-known later songs. Arista albums Sleepwalker through State of Confusion (1977–1983) reached the US Top 20; Come Dancing was the first major hit in a decade. Avory left in 1989 (Bob Henrit replaced him). Phobia (1993) included Hatred (A Duet); the band dissolved in 1996. Paul Weller, Noel Gallagher, and Damon Albarn have cited Ray; he received an OBE in 2004.
body.zh:
The Kinks 于 1963 年在伦敦成立。Ray 与 Dave Davies 曾以 Ray Davies Quartet、The Ravens 之名与同学 Pete Quaife（贝斯）组队；同年加入来自 Rolling Stones 圈子的 Mick Avory，并与 Pye 签约。

两张单曲失利后，You Really Got Me（1964）凭质朴吉他连复段登上英国榜首、美国第 7，后被视为早期 hard rock 范例。随后有 All Day and All of the Night、Tired of Waiting for You；Sunny Afternoon 与 Waterloo Sunset 亦为 Ray 所写的英国热单。Face to Face（1966）、Something Else by The Kinks（1967）继续领跑国内专辑榜。内讧与管理问题使乐队约四年未赴美巡演。

1966 年 Quaife 退出三个月（John Dalton 顶替），至 Arthur (Or the Decline and Fall of the British Empire)（1969）永久离队。Lola Versus Powerman and the Moneygoround Part One（1970）上的 Lola、Apeman 重回美国前 40；电台播 Lola 时常以 “cherry cola” 替代 “Coca-Cola”。RCA 时期国内几乎无上榜单曲；Everybody’s in Show-Biz（1972）中的 Celluloid Heroes 是 Ray 后期知名作品。Arista 旗下 Sleepwalker 至 State of Confusion（1977–1983）进入美国前 20；Come Dancing 是十年内首支大热。Avory 1989 年离队（Bob Henrit 接替）。Phobia（1993）含 Hatred (A Duet)；乐队 1996 年解散。Paul Weller、Noel Gallagher、Damon Albarn 曾称 Ray 为灵感来源；他于 2004 年获 OBE。

note.en: Third Pye single; UK #1, US #7. Plain guitar riff later treated as an early hard-rock model.
note.zh: Pye 第三张单曲；英榜首、美第 7。质朴吉他连复段后被当作早期 hard rock 范例。

note.en: UK hit written by Ray Davies; English place lyric around Waterloo.
note.zh: Ray Davies 所写英国热单；以 Waterloo 一带为场景的英式地点歌词。

note.zh: 出自 Lola Versus Powerman…；重回美国前 40。美国电台常以 “cherry cola” 替代 “Coca-Cola”。

note.en: From State of Confusion; first major hit in about ten years.
note.zh: 出自 State of Confusion；约十年内首支大热单曲。

body.en:
Ray and Dave Davies received guitars as teenagers and formed the Ray Davies Quartet. Schoolmate Pete Quaife joined on bass; the name became The Ravens. In 1963 they formed The Kinks with Mick Avory—linked to the Rolling Stones orbit—and signed to Pye.

Two early singles failed. The third, You Really Got Me (1964), reached UK #1 and US #7.
body.zh:
Ray 与 Dave Davies 少年时得到吉他，组建 Ray Davies Quartet。同学 Pete Quaife 加入贝斯后改名 The Ravens。1963 年与来自 Rolling Stones 圈子的 Mick Avory 组成 The Kinks，并与 Pye 签约。

前两张单曲失利。第三张 You Really Got Me（1964）登上英国榜首、美国第 7。

alt.zh: The Kinks 于檀香山机场，1965 年 7 月 5 日

body.en:
You Really Got Me is built on a short, plain guitar riff. All Day and All of the Night used a similar approach the same year. Tired of Waiting for You also topped the UK chart; Green Day later covered it.

These Pye 45s are the band’s main early hard-rock reference points—power chords and a distorted lead tone rather than long solos.
body.zh:
You Really Got Me 建立在短而质朴的吉他连复段上。同年的 All Day and All of the Night 写法相近。Tired of Waiting for You 亦登英国榜首；Green Day 后来翻唱过。

这些 Pye 单曲是乐队早期 hard rock 的主要参照——强力和弦与失真主音，而非长独奏。

body.en:
From Kinda Kinks and The Kinks Kontroversy (both 1965) through Face to Face (1966) and Something Else (1967), Ray Davies wrote UK hits including Sunny Afternoon and Waterloo Sunset.

Friction—especially between the Davies brothers—and management problems kept the band off US tours for about four years. From then on, albums often did better in the US than at home.
body.zh:
从 Kinda Kinks、The Kinks Kontroversy（均 1965）到 Face to Face（1966）、Something Else（1967），Ray Davies 写出 Sunny Afternoon、Waterloo Sunset 等英国热单。

内讧——尤其是 Davies 兄弟——与管理问题使乐队约四年未赴美巡演。此后专辑在美国往往比国内更受欢迎。

alt.en: The Kinks promotional photo, 1969 — Dave Davies, Ray Davies, John Dalton, Mick Avory
alt.zh: The Kinks 1969 年宣传照——Dave Davies、Ray Davies、John Dalton、Mick Avory

body.en:
In 1966 Quaife left for three months; John Dalton covered bass. Ray also briefly left for under a week in 1967. Dave’s solo single Death of a Clown (written with Ray) charted in the UK that year.

Village Green Preservation Society (1968) and Arthur (1969) were more conceptual and less commercially successful. Dalton first appeared officially on Arthur; Quaife left for good. John Gosling joined on keyboards around the Lola period (1970–1978).
body.zh:
1966 年 Quaife 退出三个月，由 John Dalton 顶替贝斯。1967 年 Ray 也曾离队不到一周。同年 Dave 个人单曲 Death of a Clown（与 Ray 合作）进入英国榜。

Village Green Preservation Society（1968）与 Arthur（1969）更偏概念，商业成绩不如从前。Dalton 在 Arthur 首次正式出现；Quaife 永久离队。John Gosling 约在 Lola 时期加入键盘（1970–1978）。

alt.en: The Kinks, c. 1970 — John Gosling, Dave Davies, Mick Avory, John Dalton, Ray Davies
alt.zh: The Kinks，约 1970——John Gosling、Dave Davies、Mick Avory、John Dalton、Ray Davies

body.en:
Lola Versus Powerman… (1970) returned the band to the US Top 40 via Lola and Apeman. Apeman was their last UK Top 10 single. Under RCA, the only notable UK chart entry was Supersonic Rocket Ship; Celluloid Heroes stood out on Everybody’s in Show-Biz (1972).

Arista albums Sleepwalker (1977), Misfits (1978), Low Budget (1979), One for the Road (1980), Give the People What They Want (1981), and State of Confusion (1983) reached the US Top 20. Come Dancing was the first big hit in a decade.
body.zh:
Lola Versus Powerman…（1970）凭 Lola、Apeman 重回美国前 40。Apeman 是乐队最后一支英国前 10 单曲。RCA 时期国内几乎只有 Supersonic Rocket Ship 上榜；Everybody’s in Show-Biz（1972）中的 Celluloid Heroes 突出。

Arista 专辑 Sleepwalker（1977）、Misfits（1978）、Low Budget（1979）、One for the Road（1980）、Give the People What They Want（1981）、State of Confusion（1983）进入美国前 20。Come Dancing 是十年内首支大热。

body.en:
Avory left in 1989; Bob Henrit took drums. Think Visual (1986) and UK Jive (1989) underperformed. Phobia (1993) included Hatred (A Duet); the band ended in 1996.

Paul Weller, Noel Gallagher, and Damon Albarn have cited Ray Davies. He received an OBE in 2004 and an Ivor Novello outstanding contribution award. See My Friends (2012) reworked older songs with guests including Bruce Springsteen and members of Metallica, Pixies, and The Smashing Pumpkins.
body.zh:
Avory 于 1989 年离队，由 Bob Henrit 接鼓。Think Visual（1986）、UK Jive（1989）成绩有限。Phobia（1993）含 Hatred (A Duet)；乐队 1996 年解散。

Paul Weller、Noel Gallagher、Damon Albarn 曾称 Ray Davies 为灵感来源。他于 2004 年获 OBE，并获 Ivor Novello 英国音乐杰出贡献奖。See My Friends（2012）重制旧曲，嘉宾包括 Bruce Springsteen，以及 Metallica、Pixies、The Smashing Pumpkins 成员等。
